# Evaluation: observations, not a benchmark

The recorded source is the pinned **marketing** competitive-brief Skill, not
product-management's same-named Skill. The later [packaging supplement](PACKAGING.md)
adds local dependency-resolution and recorded-recovery tests; it contributes no
new model run and changes none of the outcomes below. Removed redundant raw files
remain addressable through [retention.json](evidence/retention.json).

Date: 2026-10-27. Same [task](evidence/task.md), [seven fact cards](evidence/source-cards.md) and final acceptance criteria. Research was deliberately offline in both modes. Different model environments, different packaging context and assisted retry instructions prevent causal speed/cost/quality comparisons. Three baseline runs and one fresh converted Workflow are not a stability estimate.

## Results

| Measure | Original Skill | Automatic hosted Workflow | Assisted session recovery |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sample size | 3 complete CLI runs | 1 fresh conversion; separate rejected URL probe | Same session; one failed step retried |
| Conversion | Not applicable | Generated and published successfully | Generated package unchanged |
| Task completion | 3 reports delivered | Failed after 2/5 steps; no final result artifact returned | Session completed 5/5; final report available; original external task still failed |
| Report structure | 7/7 sections in each | No final `competitive_brief` at failure | 7/7 sections, 5 actions, follow-up options |
| Four annual seat subtotals | Correct in all three | Not a final-report result | Correct in recovered report |
| Sources/claim boundaries | Seven source URLs, dated scope, fact/inference/unknown labels; checks below | Intermediate research and analysis retained | URLs/date present; several overclaims and label problems remain |
| Step observability | CLI tool events and final text | Runtime step IDs, states, artifact revisions and failure reason visible | Failed and successful attempts remain visible |
| Human review | Pending; no approval claimed | No generated approval gate | Still pending; operator edit attempts failed |
| Recovery | No injected failure test | Research internally recovered from six tool errors; analysis failure stopped task | Official retry succeeded; original research reused; two downstream advances completed |
| Wall time | 146.286 / 212.477 / 133.378 s | 615.843 s from task creation to terminal failure | 1,190.634 s creation to recovered session end, including diagnosis/idle time |
| Observed tool calls | 2 / 3 / 3 file-reading commands | 28 step-level tool calls | 3 additional `save_artifacts` calls; 31 total |
| Model invocations / money | Not exposed / unavailable | Not exposed / unavailable | Not exposed / unavailable |

Baseline mean wall time is 164.047 s; median 146.286 s. These are observations of this setup, not evidence that the baseline is generally faster. The hosted timing includes conversion and publication; the baseline timing does not. The recovered-session total includes time spent investigating, writing documentation and running checks.

### Available baseline token usage

| Run | Input | Cached input (subset) | Output | Reasoning output reported by CLI |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | 58,978 | 48,896 | 4,458 | 57 |
| 2 | 59,181 | 49,024 | 5,044 | 83 |
| 3 | 59,178 | 49,024 | 4,460 | 49 |

Do not add cached input to total input. No dollar cost is inferred. Baseline model identity was not exposed in CLI JSON; Workflow connection reported DeepSeek `deepseek-flash`. Stream event counts and task `step_count` are not model invocation counts.

Workflow call totals cover execution-step tool events only. Conversion status/warnings and its generated package are recorded, but the conversion model's internal invocation/token trace was not exposed by the captured API; it is not included in those totals.

## Actual execution and failures

1. `/blob/` source probe failed `SKILL_INSTALL_FAILED` in about 1.54 s. Resubmitting the same pinned directory using `/tree/` installed the Skill. This is source-format recovery, not a successful conversion of the rejected request.
2. Preflight warned about `web_search` and missing configuration. Model generation published `competitive_brief`, revision `617f74c8-30fc-42da-84a6-0893f8fda218`. The generated package has five steps, all without mandatory approval.
3. `collect_request` succeeded. `research_competitors` made 25 calls: six save calls, thirteen patches, five reads and one file-resource search. Six returned explicit errors (invalid JSON/schema, wrong slot content type, unsupported `.draft` lookup). The lookup targeted this step's own generated draft, not a private document. Research ultimately succeeded with two competitors in revision 2. Revision 1's empty array was an intermediate save, **not** the final research result.
4. `analyze_positioning` attempt 1 saved JSON but failed the completion check demanding the final Markdown report. The external task stopped on 2026-10-27 at 03:46:59.243124 UTC. See [issue record](ISSUES.md).
5. An agent-authored, explicitly step-scoped retry used the official advance API with `retry_origin: automatic`. It retained final acceptance for the downstream report. The HTTP recorder timed out after 90 s; projection later confirmed attempt 2 succeeded. No duplicate mutation was sent. The retry reused research revision 2 and request revision 1.
6. Two further official advances ran synthesis with the original full input and the generated no-battlecard-request branch. The session reached `completed` / `end_reached: true` at 03:56:34.034513 UTC. This is assisted recovery, not an unassisted success or hand-written Workflow adaptation.
7. A reversible agent-only annotation was attempted through artifact PATCH: HTTP 503 `ARTIFACT_PATCH_FAILED`. The documented native slot PATCH also returned HTTP 500. Reads confirmed the report remained revision 1 with unchanged content. No successful edit, rollback or human review is claimed.

The [actual recovered Panel](evidence/panel-recovered.png) displays a completed session beside the original failed external-task message. Both are real and refer to different state records. The report is shown as raw Markdown in the observed Panel; the existence of this Panel is not proof of polished rendering or successful editing.

## Report acceptance and groundedness review

Checks apply to the delivered text, not a model's claim that it complied. The checker verifies all seven headings, seven official URLs, source date, review-pending boundary, claim-label vocabulary and four subtotals: Linear Basic $2,400, Linear Business $3,840, Asana Starter $2,637.60, Asana Advanced $5,997.60. These are annual seat arithmetic, not total cost of ownership.

The operator also compared the four plan rows and selected positioning/content statements to S1–S7. Baseline outputs preserve the distinction between sampled vendor claims and unknown market metrics in those inspected areas. This is a bounded content audit, not independent human review or a claim that every sentence is flawless. All raw reports remain available for inspection.

The recovered [Workflow report](evidence/artifacts/competitive_brief.md) passes structural/arithmetic checks but **does not fully pass groundedness acceptance**:

| Location | Observed problem | Needed revision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Executive Summary | “Neither vendor publishes the numbers a 20-seat budget actually needs” exceeds a seven-card corpus | Say those costs are unavailable in the supplied cards; do not assert absence across vendor publications |
| Linear strengths | “genuinely usable free tier” and reduced trial friction are labelled FACT | Retain entitlement facts, label usability/trial-friction interpretation as an untested inference |
| Linear claimed differentiators | “AI embedded natively rather than added on” lacks support in S2/S3 | Remove the architecture/implementation claim |
| Content formats | “gated long-form authority” assumes access gating not established by S6 | Remove “gated” or collect evidence in a separate run |
| Pricing table | Asana Personal has a $0 entry under the 20-seat column despite its stated two-user limit | Mark 20-person eligibility unavailable/not applicable; the four paid-plan calculations are correct |
| Opportunities/threats | Some implications and future predictions carry FACT citations without clear inference labels | Split supported observations from analysis; remove unsupported quarter-specific forecasts |

The generated schema calls the source mode `model_knowledge`, while the actual task and artifacts explicitly describe offline supplied-source replay. Tool records contain no live search calls. Treat the schema label as misleading metadata, not evidence of live retrieval or a reason to silently relabel the raw artifact.

## Verification and limits

- `scripts/verify.py`: evidence hashes, terminal states, artifact/attempt counts, section/citation/arithmetic smoke checks, redaction patterns and Markdown/internal links. Passing these checks does not override the substantive findings above.
- Current-main focused Go source-URL and hosted conversion/task tests passed. Current-main Python SDK and agent-kit tests: **92 passed**. Logs are under [checks](evidence/checks/); these tests are separate from the live deployment.
- `git diff --check` and Python syntax checks passed during submission preparation.
- No production changes, no model mocks, no fake success state, no generated screenshot. A real local deployment and authenticated model connection were used.
- Not validated: enforced human approval, successful artifact edit/rollback, a second converted run, same-model comparison, dollar cost, independent vendor correctness, live web research or exact deployed source commit.

This supports an honest PM-facing account of what worked, what needed intervention and what still needs review. It does **not** support a promotion claiming stable autonomous end-to-end success, a quality win or cost savings.

# Observed issues; no production fix in this PR

## Intermediate output judged as final deliverable

The published `analyze_positioning` node declares a `positioning_analysis` JSON output. Attempt 1 wrote that artifact, then failed with `objective_incomplete`: the verifier required the complete seven-section Markdown report, including pricing arithmetic, which belongs to the downstream `synthesize_brief` node. The external task became `failed` / `WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_FAILED`.

Evidence: [failed step task](evidence/http/analysis-task-failed.json), [failed projection](evidence/http/projection-failed.json), [terminal external task](evidence/http/tree-status-8.json), and the unchanged [generated graph](evidence/generated/workflow.yaml).

**Hypothesis, not a proven code-level root cause:** the end-to-end user objective is being used as the intermediate step's completion criterion. The successful retry explicitly scoped the objective/user input/runtime instruction to the intermediate JSON contract while retaining every final-report requirement for synthesis. This intervention supports the hypothesis but does not establish which layer needs a fix.

Reproduce with the pinned directory URL, frozen task/corpus and a fresh hosted task as documented in [Reproduction](REPRODUCTION.md). Model generation is nondeterministic; retain the generated package and deployment provenance when comparing attempts. Do not weaken final acceptance or replace auto-generated YAML to claim success.

## URL and dependency fidelity

The user-facing `/blob/.../SKILL.md` URL queued successfully but later failed installation. Using the supported directory URL recovered installation. The imported directory omits the Skill's parent-relative CONNECTORS reference; Preflight warned about missing web-search capability configuration but did not report that missing file. It also adds a default script absent from upstream. See [audit](AUDIT.md) and [snapshot metadata](evidence/skill-snapshot-metadata.json).

The affected source here is `marketing/skills/competitive-brief` at the pinned
commit, not product-management's homonym. The [local packaging supplement](PACKAGING.md)
copies the matching marketing CONNECTORS into the generated archive and verifies
its link locally. This repairs that standalone package's dependency closure; it
does not fix Claude.ai's installer or prove the adapted package runs in LazyMind.

## Review and recovery boundaries

Every generated node has `requires_approval: false`; no actual human approval occurred. A manual advance request took longer than the recorder's 90-second HTTP timeout, but subsequent projection showed it had succeeded. A transport timeout is not evidence that a command failed. Inspect command/session state before retrying a mutation.

The already terminal external task did not resume itself after the separate session retry. Preserve both task and session states. Do not overwrite the original task's failure with a recovered session result.

## Artifact edit failure in this deployment

After session completion, PATCH of the report artifact with base revision 1 and draft version 1 returned HTTP 503 `ARTIFACT_PATCH_FAILED` (retryable). The documented native slot-item PATCH returned HTTP 500 `patch item failed`. Both requests attempted only an explicit agent-authored annotation; neither claimed human review. Subsequent reads retained revision 1 and the original bytes. Evidence: [facade response](evidence/http/edit-response.json), [native response](evidence/http/slot-edit-response.json), [unchanged slots](evidence/http/slots-final.json).

The serving binary lacks a VCS revision and no private server/database logs were inspected, so the cause is unresolved. This is a deployment observation, not a proven defect in the audited current-main commit. No production repair is included in this documentation PR.

# Portable marketing Skill supplement

This extends the existing experiment in this directory. It does not create a
second Example, fix Claude.ai's installer, or change LazyMind Core. The original
execution evidence remains about the unmodified upstream marketing Skill.

## Two different Skills with the same name

Both files exist at commit `c75fda00ff0e41c8ee331ae312c8a07f1967653b`:

| Source path | Git blob | Scope | PR #873 execution evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `marketing/skills/competitive-brief/SKILL.md` | `1a7df218996ed350c67e6899a60321f205bb69d6` | Positioning, messaging and content gaps; seven-section report | Yes, with the failures recorded in EVALUATION.md |
| `product-management/skills/competitive-brief/SKILL.md` | `05ca7ec4314ec1a73a882562a364726870944cff` | Product/feature comparison and product-strategy implications | None in this experiment |

The PM-oriented business task does not change the source Skill's identity. The
marketing dependency is `marketing/CONNECTORS.md`, blob
`f4d375273c56cfeb923022556ac5ec60e4c818ff`. The product-management dependency is a
different file, blob `aa15b5ccfb4cd0a5d8ea668632634c25061bb40b`. Exact paths, sizes,
SHA-256 digests and source links are recoverable from [source-lock.json](source-lock.json).
Match repository + commit + path + blob, never the frontmatter name alone.

## Dependency failure and local repair

The pinned marketing directory contains only SKILL.md. Its `../../CONNECTORS.md`
link works inside the complete upstream plugin but escapes a standalone Skill
directory. The recorded LazyMind import contains SKILL.md and a platform-added
run.py, not CONNECTORS.md. Preflight did not flag the missing parent reference.
This is consistent with upstream [Issue #1381](https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins/issues/1381),
but this supplement neither modifies nor tests Claude.ai's installer.

The builder emits a local folder and deterministic ZIP containing:

```text
SKILL.md
references/CONNECTORS.md
LICENSE
NOTICE.txt
ORIGIN.json
```

The only Skill changes are a `competitive-brief-marketing` name/slash-trigger
alias, a local CONNECTORS link and a modification notice. The research
instructions are otherwise byte-equivalent after reversing those changes.
CONNECTORS and LICENSE are copied exactly. The upstream LICENSE has nonstandard
trailing text, which is retained rather than silently normalized. The pinned
upstream tree contains no NOTICE file. Source bodies and generated ZIPs are not
committed in this PR; attribution and exact hashes accompany generated packages.

CONNECTORS is a category catalog, not tool configuration. Its reference to an
upstream `.mcp.json` does not imply this package includes one. No server, API key,
subscription, permission or web-search capability is provisioned. The original
offline task and fact cards remain separate explicit inputs.

## Build and check without a model

Use Python 3.10+ and a fresh output path. With a checkout of the pinned upstream
commit (or the exact three files in their original paths):

```sh
python3 examples/competitive-brief-skill2workflow/scripts/package_skill.py \
  --source-root /path/to/pinned/knowledge-work-plugins \
  --out /tmp/competitive-brief-package-new
```

Alternatively replace `--source-root ...` with `--fetch`. That option performs
three bounded public reads, verifies all hashes and stops on any HTTP error; it
does not search for credentials or retry around access/rate limits. The offline
mode is suitable for public files obtained through an authorized connector.

The ZIP has SKILL.md at its root. The existing Core source contract accepts
`skill.zip_base64` with `skill.zip_sha256` instead of `skill.url`; see
`backend/core/workflow/external_agent_skill.go` at audited commit
`71a0e5a829f1ef8d9a5d9e9ce720386ba3c69d0e`. This is implementation evidence, not
proof that the newly packaged variant has been installed or executed. Inspect
the generated folder before an authorized test import; do not replace the
original experiment's provenance with this adapted source.

For the focused tests, the source checkout must also contain the pinned
product-management SKILL.md used as a deliberate wrong-source input:

```sh
python3 examples/competitive-brief-skill2workflow/scripts/test_supplement.py \
  --source-root /path/to/pinned/knowledge-work-plugins -v
python3 examples/competitive-brief-skill2workflow/scripts/check_recovery.py
```

Fifteen tests cover the missing dependency, standalone link resolution,
same-name source rejection, altered connector rejection, path escape, exact
limited transformations, deterministic ZIP output and preservation of recorded
failure/recovery semantics. The recovery tests replay the original real API
records and mutate copies to ensure misleading success claims are rejected.
They do not simulate a successful live product run. The original verifier also
calls the recovery consistency checks.

## Evidence reduction and remaining acceptance

[retention.json](evidence/retention.json) lists 19 removed files and their hashes:
repeated polls/projections, repeated response bodies, one redundant screenshot,
an intermediate artifact and the full edit request containing a duplicate report.
Their 326,092 bytes remain available at the pinned original commit. Terminal
task failure, failed/completed session projections, unchanged graph, actual retry
request/command, reused input revision witnesses, failed edit responses, final
report, baseline outputs and the recovered screenshot remain in the working
tree. No failure was removed to improve the outcome.

The local package resolves its bundled dependency and reproduces byte-for-byte.
The existing recordings confirm same-session assisted recovery with reused
inputs, not autonomous E2E success. Execution failure, groundedness problems,
503/500 edit failures and lack of mandatory/human approval remain unchanged.
The package has not had a new hosted import/conversion run. Keep the PR Draft
until its intended acceptance scope and these remaining gaps have been reviewed;
do not advertise a successful autonomous business Showcase.

# Competitive Brief：真实 Skill2Workflow 兼容性实验

[English](README.md) · [复现](REPRODUCTION.md) · [评估](EVALUATION.md) · [实现审计](AUDIT.md) · [来源](SOURCES.md) · [独立打包](PACKAGING.md)

**状态：兼容性实验，不是自主执行成功的 Showcase。** 本案例实际安装、自动转换并发布了 Anthropic 的 competitive-brief Skill，也实际启动了 Workflow。首次外部任务在五个步骤中的第三步失败。通过官方接口限定重试步骤的交付范围后，该步骤恢复成功；原始失败记录予以保留。生成的 Workflow 没有被手写版本替换。

后续有干预推进完成了会话并交付报告。但报告仍有事实边界问题，两条编辑接口测试均失败，人工审核仍未完成，因此以 Draft 兼容性报告投稿。

本实验输入明确是 **marketing/skills/competitive-brief**，不是同名的 product-management 版本。
本次在同一 Example 中补充固定源哈希的独立打包方案：内置 marketing CONNECTORS，修正相对引用，保留许可与来源，并使用 marketing 专属名称避免混淆。
15 项新增测试只覆盖本地依赖解析、可复现 ZIP 和既有步骤观测/辅助恢复记录；没有重跑模型实验，也没有把打包成功写成安装或业务 E2E 成功。
19 份重复或非必要原始记录从当前目录移出，原 commit 与哈希可追溯，执行/编辑失败、恢复过程和最终报告均保留。

## 产品经理要解决的问题

为一个 20 人软件团队比较 Linear 与 Asana，覆盖产品研发协作和跨职能发布计划。报告要求包含七个章节、功能与定位对照、按年付费的单价和 20 人年度费用、内容缺口假设、3–5 项建议，以及事实、推断、未知信息和待人工审核的明确边界。

原 Skill 提供研究方法。转成 Workflow 的动机是分别检查研究、定位分析和报告，并在失败时复用已有产物。本实验验证这些能力实际如何工作，不把有面板等同于更可靠。

## 已执行的范围

- 原始 Skill 在 Codex CLI 中完整运行三次，实际报告和工具记录位于 [baseline](evidence/baseline/)。
- SKILL.md 的 `/blob/` URL 安装失败；改用相同 commit 的目录 `/tree/` URL 后，经正式外部任务入口完成安装、Preflight、模型转换、发布和执行。
- 自动生成五步：需求整理、竞品研究、定位分析、报告综合、可选战卡。首次自动执行完成前两步，第三步因中间 JSON 被按最终 Markdown 报告验收而失败。
- 官方重试和后续推进属于**有干预恢复实验**，与首次自动执行的结果分开报告。详见 [评估](EVALUATION.md) 和 [问题记录](ISSUES.md)。

两种模式都使用同一份任务和七张官方资料卡。资料获取阶段真实联网，模型执行阶段明确为**离线回放**；资料卡是研究者选择的公开网页事实摘要，并非完整网页镜像。没有使用付费数据库、私人材料或登录竞品账号。

## 能说明什么

可以说明这个 Skill 的自动转换链路确实被执行、步骤与产物可以观察，以及本次失败如何通过官方接口恢复。不能说明端到端自主执行稳定、报告必然更好、成本更低或已完成人工审核。实际部署的 Core 缺少 VCS 信息，不能把本地部署运行结果等同于被审计 main commit 的 E2E 结果。

本案例适合评估可检查研究流程的产品经理，以及排查 Skill 兼容性的维护者。它区别于已有 Product Solution Delivery 的人工适配，也区别于 Superpowers 案例：这里保留了独立 Skill 来源、真正自动生成的包、原 Skill 的固定资料基线，以及失败和恢复证据。

真实运行截图见 [英文说明](README.md)。没有使用模拟截图；报告中的 “Human review: pending” 不是人工批准，也不是系统强制审核关卡。

# Competitive Brief: a real Skill2Workflow compatibility trial

[中文](README.CN.md) · [Reproduction](REPRODUCTION.md) · [Evaluation](EVALUATION.md) · [Implementation audit](AUDIT.md) · [Sources](SOURCES.md) · [Portable packaging](PACKAGING.md)

**Status: compatibility experiment, not a successful autonomous Showcase.** Anthropic's pinned competitive-brief Skill was genuinely installed, converted by LazyMind's hosted model-backed service, published and executed. The first external task failed at the third of five generated steps. A step-scoped retry recovered that step without changing the generated Workflow. The original failed task remains part of the evidence.

Assisted continuation subsequently completed the session and produced a report. That report still has groundedness issues, both tested edit routes failed, and human review remains pending. These limits are why this case is submitted as a Draft compatibility report.

The source is **marketing/skills/competitive-brief**, not the same-named
product-management Skill. The [packaging supplement](PACKAGING.md) adds a pinned,
dependency-complete local package and focused offline checks to this same Example;
it does not rerun the model experiment or turn the adapted package into E2E evidence.

## Business question

A PM at a 20-person software team needs to compare Linear and Asana for product development and cross-functional launch planning. The deliverable is a seven-section competitive brief with product positioning, features, annual seat pricing, evidence-bounded content gaps and 3–5 actions. Facts, inferences and unavailable information must be distinguishable; a person must review the recommendation before acting.

The original Skill packages useful research instructions. A Workflow could make the research, analysis and report individually inspectable and recoverable. This experiment tests that proposition with real outputs rather than assuming that a graph guarantees reliability.

## What was actually run

- Three original-Skill Codex CLI runs, each reading the pinned Skill, its CONNECTORS reference and the same frozen task/corpus.
- One rejected GitHub `/blob/.../SKILL.md` import probe, followed by one supported pinned `/tree/.../competitive-brief` submission.
- Automatic installation → Preflight → generation → publication → execution through `POST /external-agent/workflow-tasks`.
- The generated five-step package and actual session projections, artifact revisions and failure records are preserved. No production code, original Skill text or generated YAML was edited to make the run pass.
- A separate assisted recovery uses the official session advance API. Its results are distinguished from the failed autonomous run in [Evaluation](EVALUATION.md).

Both modes used **offline replay of seven operator-selected, paraphrased official-source fact cards**, acquired live on 2026-10-27. This tests bounded synthesis and orchestration; it does not test live retrieval, paid market intelligence, product usability or complete market coverage.

## Read the evidence

| Evidence | Location |
| --- | --- |
| Fixed inputs and acceptance | [Task](evidence/task.md), [source cards](evidence/source-cards.md) |
| Original-Skill reports | [Run 1](evidence/baseline/run-1.md), [run 2](evidence/baseline/run-2.md), [run 3](evidence/baseline/run-3.md) |
| Actual generated package | [workflow.yaml](evidence/generated/workflow.yaml), [state.yml](evidence/generated/state.yml), [scenario](evidence/generated/scenario.md) |
| Conversion and execution states | [HTTP recordings](evidence/http/), [manifest](evidence/manifest.json) |
| Runtime provenance | [Environment](evidence/environment.json) |
| Observed product issues | [Issue record](ISSUES.md) |

The real Panel screenshot below shows the recovered session alongside the original
failed task. It demonstrates assisted session completion, not autonomous success
or human approval. Repeated polling records and the earlier running screenshot
remain accessible through the [retention inventory](evidence/retention.json).

![Actual recovered session beside the original failed task](evidence/panel-recovered.png)

## Limits and intended audience

This is useful for PMs and knowledge workers evaluating inspectable research handoffs, and maintainers checking Skill compatibility. It is not evidence of better output quality, lower cost or general conversion stability. The deployed Core binary has a recorded hash but no VCS revision; current-main code audit/regression tests and deployed E2E evidence are explicitly separate. No human approval was obtained, and generated steps contain no mandatory approval gate.

Unlike the existing Product Solution Delivery package and the Superpowers example, this case starts from an independently pinned knowledge-work Skill and exercises hosted automatic conversion with a fixed-corpus original-Skill baseline.

# Reproduction

This is a real-service experiment. The scripts do not install a server, supply a model, impersonate an account, mock results or approve a human gate. A successful run may consume model quota. Use your own authorized local/test instance and a fresh output directory for every command.

## Environment and inputs

Recorded host: macOS arm64, Codex CLI `0.155.0-alpha.9`, Core built with Go 1.25.11, connection reporting DeepSeek `deepseek-flash`. Audited checkout: `71a0e5a829f1ef8d9a5d9e9ce720386ba3c69d0e`. The deployed binary has no VCS stamp; [environment.json](evidence/environment.json) records its hash. A rerun on another build/model is a new experiment, not an exact deterministic replay.

The original worktree and its uncommitted submodule change were left untouched. A separate branch/worktree was created from fetched main. This PR modifies only this example and the two examples indexes. A normal already-paired local authentication connection was used. No credentials, private sessions, database contents or unrelated documents are part of the evidence.

Read [Sources](SOURCES.md) before running. The pinned Skill references a parent CONNECTORS file; baseline downloads it separately, while the hosted directory importer omits it. Baseline run 1 had one extra trailing newline in SKILL.md; runs 2–3 and the imported Skill match its exact Git blob. All modes use identical task/corpus bytes. This scoped offline variant deliberately leaves market/SEO/review intelligence unavailable instead of quietly supplying easier substitute metrics.

## Check committed evidence without a model

For the new dependency-complete marketing package and focused offline tests, use
[PACKAGING.md](PACKAGING.md). It distinguishes the same-named upstream Skills and
does not replace the original experiment below. No new model runs are required
to check this supplement.

"""Read-only consistency checks over the original real-service recordings.

These checks issue no API calls and cannot turn the recorded assisted recovery
into a new runtime test, an autonomous success, or an edit/approval success.
"""
import json
from pathlib import Path

EVIDENCE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'evidence'


def load_records(root=EVIDENCE):
    names = ['http/projection-failed.json', 'http/projection-completed.json',
             'http/tree-status-8.json', 'http/external-after-recovery.json',
             'http/retry-command.json', 'requests/retry-analysis-request.json',
             'http/retry-transport.json', 'http/slots-synthesis.json', 'http/slots-final.json',
             'http/edit-response.json', 'http/slot-edit-response.json']
    return {name: json.loads((root / name).read_text()) for name in names}


def payload(record):
    response = record['response']
    return response.get('result', response.get('data', response))


def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def check(records):
    failed = payload(records['http/projection-failed.json'])
    final = payload(records['http/projection-completed.json'])
    before = payload(records['http/tree-status-8.json'])
    after = payload(records['http/external-after-recovery.json'])
    request = records['requests/retry-analysis-request.json']
    command = payload(records['http/retry-command.json'])
    require(before['status'] == after['status'] == 'failed' and not after['result_ready'],
            'Original external task failure must survive recovery')
    require(before['task_id'] == after['task_id'], 'External task identity changed')
    require(before['progress']['completed_steps'] == 2, 'Autonomous result was not 2/5')
    require(failed['session_id'] == final['session_id'] == request['session_id'] == command['SessionID'],
            'Recovery belongs to a different session')
    require(failed['graph_hash'] == final['graph_hash'] and failed['graph'] == final['graph'],
            'Recovery changed the published graph')
    require('analyze_positioning' in failed['projection']['retryable'], 'Failure was not retryable')
    nodes = final['projection']['nodes']
    require(final['status'] == 'completed' and final['projection']['completed'] and
            final['projection']['end_reached'] and len(nodes) == 5 and
            all(n['execution'] == 'succeeded' for n in nodes.values()), 'Session not completed 5/5')
    require(all(not n['requires_approval'] for n in nodes.values()), 'Unexpected human approval claim')
    attempts = final['attempt_history']['analyze_positioning']
    require([a['status'] for a in attempts] == ['failed', 'succeeded'], 'Failed attempt was lost')
    require(attempts[0]['attempt_id'] == failed['attempt_history']['analyze_positioning'][0]['attempt_id'],
            'Original failed attempt identity lost')
    for step in ('collect_request', 'research_competitors'):
        require(final['attempt_history'][step] == failed['attempt_history'][step],
                'Upstream work reran: ' + step)
    prior_inputs = failed['input_witnesses'][attempts[0]['attempt_id']]
    retry_inputs = final['input_witnesses'][attempts[1]['attempt_id']]
    require(prior_inputs == retry_inputs and {x['material_id'] for x in retry_inputs} ==
            {'competitor_research', 'request_brief'}, 'Retry did not reuse original input revisions')
    require(request['retry_origin'] == 'automatic' and len(request['steps']) == 1 and
            request['steps'][0]['step_id'] == 'analyze_positioning', 'Retry scope/origin changed')
    accepted = command['ResponseJSON']
    require(command['CommandID'] == request['command_id'] == accepted['command_id'] and
            accepted['accepted'] and accepted['task_id'] == attempts[1]['task_id'],
            'Accepted command does not match the successful retry')
    require('socket.timeout' in records['http/retry-transport.json']['outcome'], 'Lost timeout observation')
    require(records['http/edit-response.json']['http_status'] == 503 and
            records['http/slot-edit-response.json']['http_status'] == 500, 'Edit failures changed')
    def report(name):
        return next(s for s in payload(records[name])['slots'] if s['slot_id'] == 'competitive_brief')
    old_report, new_report = report('http/slots-synthesis.json'), report('http/slots-final.json')
    require(old_report['revision'] == new_report['revision'] == 1 and
            old_report['artifact_id'] == new_report['artifact_id'] and
            old_report['artifact_value'] == new_report['artifact_value'], 'Failed edits changed report')
    return {'mode': 'recorded_evidence_replay', 'autonomous_external_task': 'failed',
            'assisted_session': 'completed', 'prior_inputs_reused': True,
            'human_approval_verified': False, 'artifact_edit_succeeded': False,
            'new_live_runs': 0}


if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(json.dumps(check(load_records()), indent=2))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build a pinned, dependency-complete marketing Skill locally; never install/run it.

Upstream bodies stay outside Git. Use --source-root for an offline pinned checkout,
or --fetch for three bounded public reads. An output directory must be new.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import posixpath
import re
from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
from urllib.request import build_opener, HTTPRedirectHandler, Request
from zipfile import ZipFile, ZipInfo, ZIP_STORED

CASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
LOCK = json.loads((CASE / 'source-lock.json').read_text())
ALIAS = 'competitive-brief-marketing'
OLD_LINK = '../../CONNECTORS.md'
NEW_LINK = 'references/CONNECTORS.md'
CHANGE_NOTE = '<!-- Local packaging adaptation: marketing alias and bundled CONNECTORS link only; see ORIGIN.json and NOTICE.txt. -->\n'


def sha256(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def verify_source(raw, spec):
    blob = hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(raw)).encode() + b'\0' + raw).hexdigest()
    if (len(raw), blob, sha256(raw)) != (spec['bytes'], spec['blob'], spec['sha256']):
        raise ValueError('Pinned source mismatch: ' + spec['path'])


def check_links(files):
    """Check inline Markdown file links in this pinned package (no external reads)."""
    for name, raw in files.items():
        if not name.endswith('.md'):
            continue
        for target in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]\n]*\]\(([^)\s]+)\)', raw.decode()):
            parsed = urlsplit(target)
            if parsed.scheme or parsed.netloc or not parsed.path:
                continue
            decoded = unquote(parsed.path)
            resolved = posixpath.normpath(posixpath.join(str(PurePosixPath(name).parent), decoded))
            if decoded.startswith('/') or resolved == '..' or resolved.startswith('../') or resolved not in files:
                raise ValueError(f'Unresolved package dependency: {name} -> {target}')


def assemble(inputs):
    for key in ('primary', 'dependency', 'license'):
        verify_source(inputs[key], LOCK[key])
    original = inputs['primary'].decode()
    if original.count(OLD_LINK) != 1 or original.count('name: competitive-brief\n') != 1:
        raise ValueError('Unexpected upstream layout')
    adapted = original.replace('name: competitive-brief\n', f'name: {ALIAS}\n', 1)
    adapted = adapted.replace('`/competitive-brief`', f'`/{ALIAS}`')
    adapted = adapted.replace(OLD_LINK, NEW_LINK, 1)
    # Leave the frontmatter first for ordinary Skill installers.
    end = adapted.index('\n---\n', 4) + len('\n---\n')
    adapted = adapted[:end] + '\n' + CHANGE_NOTE + adapted[end:]
    origin = {
        'repository': LOCK['repository'], 'commit': LOCK['commit'],
        'primary': LOCK['primary'], 'dependency': LOCK['dependency'], 'license': LOCK['license'],
        'package_name': ALIAS,
        'changes': ['Skill name and slash trigger use marketing alias',
                    'CONNECTORS link rewritten to bundled references/CONNECTORS.md',
                    'Added modification notice; other instructions unchanged'],
        'packaged_skill_sha256': sha256(adapted.encode()),
        'execution_status': 'not_run: no install, model conversion or execution by this builder',
        'connector_configuration': 'Catalog text only; no .mcp.json, servers, tokens or permissions installed',
    }
    notice = (f'Derived from Anthropic {LOCK["repository"]}, commit {LOCK["commit"]}.\n'
              f'Original Skill: {LOCK["primary"]["path"]}\n'
              f'Dependency: {LOCK["dependency"]["path"]}\n'
              'The upstream LICENSE is copied byte-for-byte, including its trailing text.\n'
              'Local modifications: marketing-specific name/trigger, dependency link and this notice.\n'
              'No other upstream instructions changed. No affiliation or endorsement claimed.\n'
              'CONNECTORS describes categories; copying it does not provision any connector.\n'
              'This is a portable example package, not a fix to any official installer.\n')
    files = {'SKILL.md': adapted.encode(), NEW_LINK: inputs['dependency'],
             'LICENSE': inputs['license'], 'NOTICE.txt': notice.encode(),
             'ORIGIN.json': (json.dumps(origin, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n').encode()}
    check_links(files)
    return files


class NoRedirect(HTTPRedirectHandler):
    def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl):
        raise ValueError('Unexpected redirect; recheck the pinned source')


def inputs_from(source_root=None):
    inputs = {}
    opener = build_opener(NoRedirect)
    for key in ('primary', 'dependency', 'license'):
        spec = LOCK[key]
        if source_root is not None:
            raw = (source_root / spec['path']).read_bytes()
        else:
            url = f'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{LOCK["repository"]}/{LOCK["commit"]}/{spec["path"]}'
            with opener.open(Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'LazyMind-pinned-example'}), timeout=30) as r:
                raw = r.read(65537)
        if len(raw) > 65536:
            raise ValueError('Source exceeds bounded size')
        verify_source(raw, spec)
        inputs[key] = raw
    return inputs


def build(out, inputs):
    files = assemble(inputs)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    package = out / ALIAS
    for name, raw in files.items():
        path = package / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_bytes(raw)
    archive = out / (ALIAS + '.zip')
    with ZipFile(archive, 'w', compression=ZIP_STORED) as z:
        for name, raw in sorted(files.items()):
            info = ZipInfo(name, date_time=(1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
            info.create_system = 3
            info.external_attr = 0o100644 << 16
            z.writestr(info, raw)
    receipt = {'mode': 'local dependency packaging only; no runtime E2E',
               'source_commit': LOCK['commit'], 'source_path': LOCK['primary']['path'],
               'archive': archive.name, 'archive_sha256': sha256(archive.read_bytes()),
               'files': {n: {'bytes': len(r), 'sha256': sha256(r)} for n, r in sorted(files.items())}}
    (out / 'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
    return receipt


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    mode.add_argument('--source-root', type=Path, help='Pinned upstream checkout or verified files; no network')
    mode.add_argument('--fetch', action='store_true', help='Read three pinned public files; stop on any HTTP error')
    parser.add_argument('--out', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    receipt = build(args.out, inputs_from(args.source_root))
    print(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

def report_checks(path):
    text = path.read_text()
    for section in SECTIONS:
        check(re.search(r'^##\s+(?:\d+\.\s*)?' + re.escape(section), text, re.M),
              f'{path.name}: missing section {section}')
    for url in URLS:
        check(url in text, f'{path.name}: missing source URL {url}')
    check('2026-10-27' in text or 'October 27, 2026' in text, f'{path.name}: missing source date')
    for word in ['Human review: pending', 'FACT', 'INFERENCE', 'UNKNOWN']:
        check(word in text, f'{path.name}: missing {word}')
    for amount in ['2400', '3840', '2637.60', '5997.60']:
        check(amount in text.replace(',', ''), f'{path.name}: missing subtotal {amount}')


def main():
    check_recovery(load_records())
    manifest = read('manifest.json')
    actual = {str(p.relative_to(EVIDENCE)) for p in EVIDENCE.rglob('*')
              if p.is_file() and p.name != 'manifest.json'}
    check(actual == set(manifest['files']), 'Manifest file inventory differs')
    for name, meta in manifest['files'].items():
        raw = (EVIDENCE / name).read_bytes()
        check(len(raw) == meta['bytes'], f'{name}: size differs')
        check(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == meta['sha256'], f'{name}: hash differs')

    check(data('blob-result')['error_code'] == 'SKILL_INSTALL_FAILED', 'URL probe outcome differs')
    metadata = read('generated/metadata.json')
    check(metadata['generate_status'] == 'done' and metadata['published'], 'Publication missing')
    check(metadata['current_revision_id'] == manifest['workflow_revision'], 'Revision differs')
    original = data('tree-status-8')
    check(original['status'] == 'failed' and original['result_ready'] is False, 'Original failure lost')
    check(original['progress']['completed_steps'] == 2, 'Original step count differs')
    check(data('external-after-recovery')['status'] == 'failed', 'External outcome was rewritten')
    projection = data('projection-completed')
    check(projection['status'] == 'completed' and projection['projection']['completed'], 'Recovery incomplete')
    nodes = projection['projection']['nodes']
    check(len(nodes) == 5 and all(n['execution'] == 'succeeded' for n in nodes.values()), 'Recovered steps differ')
    check(all(not n['requires_approval'] for n in nodes.values()), 'Approval-gate claim differs')
    attempts = projection['attempt_history']['analyze_positioning']
    check([a['status'] for a in attempts] == ['failed', 'succeeded'], 'Retry history missing')
    check(read('http/edit-response.json')['http_status'] == 503, 'Facade edit failure missing')
    check(read('http/slot-edit-response.json')['http_status'] == 500, 'Native edit failure missing')
    slots = data('slots-final')['slots']
    report = next(s for s in slots if s['slot_id'] == 'competitive_brief')
    check(report['revision'] == 1, 'Failed edits changed report revision')
    research = read('artifacts/research-revision-2.json')
    check(len(research['competitors']) == 2, 'Final research differs from the two-product corpus')
    summary = read('tool-summary.json')
    check(sum(sum(t.values()) for t in summary.values()) == 31, 'Step tool-call count differs')
    check(all('web_search' not in t for t in summary.values()), 'Unexpected live search tool')
    for n in range(1, 4):
        run = read(f'baseline/run-{n}.json')
        check(run['exit_code'] == 0 and run['elapsed_seconds'] > 0, 'Baseline did not finish')
        check(run['cost_usd'] is None and run['model_calls'] is None, 'Unavailable metrics fabricated')
        report_checks(EVIDENCE / f'baseline/run-{n}.md')
    report_checks(EVIDENCE / 'artifacts/competitive_brief.md')
    acquisition = read('acquisition.json')
    check(len(acquisition) == 7 and all(r['status'] == 200 for r in acquisition), 'Source acquisition differs')

    parser = MarkdownIt()
    docs = list(CASE.rglob('*.md')) + [CASE.parent / 'README.md', CASE.parent / 'README.CN.md']
    links = 0
    for path in docs:
        text = path.read_text()
        check(not re.search(r'[ \t]+$', text, re.M), f'{path}: trailing whitespace')
        for token in parser.parse(text):
            for child in token.children or []:
                target = child.attrGet('href') if child.type == 'link_open' else child.attrGet('src') if child.type == 'image' else None
                if target is None:
                    continue
                check(bool(target.strip()), f'{path}: empty link')
                parsed = urlsplit(target)
                if parsed.scheme or parsed.netloc or not parsed.path:
                    continue
                resolved = (path.parent / unquote(parsed.path)).resolve()
                check(resolved.exists(), f'{path}: missing local link {target}')
                links += 1
    for path in EVIDENCE.rglob('*'):
        if not path.is_file() or path.suffix == '.png':
            continue
        text = path.read_text()
        check('/Users/' not in text, f'{path}: private absolute path')
        check(not re.search(r'user:[a-f0-9-]{36}:', text), f'{path}: unredacted owner ref')
        check(not re.search(r'eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\.', text), f'{path}: possible JWT')
    print(f'PASS: {len(actual)} hashed evidence files, 4 report structure/arithmetic checks, '
          f'{len(docs)} Markdown files and {links} local links; observed failures preserved.')
    print('Groundedness issues, failed editing and pending human review remain; see EVALUATION.md.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
